title: 1.2 Arithmetic and Geometric Sequences
description: Ten challenging questions on sums, term counts, and mixed arithmetic-geometric problems.

questions.question: An arithmetic sequence has $a_1 = 3$ and $d = 2$. What is the sum of the first 20 terms?
A geometric sequence has $a_1 = 2$ and $r = 3$. What is the sum of the first 6 terms?
An arithmetic sequence has $a_5 = 17$ and $a_{10} = 37$. What are $a_1$ and $d$?
A geometric sequence has $a_1 = 5$ and $a_4 = 40$. What is the sum of the first 5 terms?
How many terms are in the arithmetic sequence 3, 7, 11, ..., 99?
Three numbers are in arithmetic progression and their sum is 15. What is the middle term?
